concepts.why: The patient's ECG findings show first-degree atrioventricular block and third-degree AV block with a minimum heart rate of 36 beats/min, indicating a high-grade atrioventricular block.
The patient's echocardiogram findings show pulmonary hypertension with a mean pulmonary arterial pressure of 32 mm Hg.
The patient's echocardiogram findings show left atrial enlargement with a volume index of 34.89 mL/m2.
The patient's elevated blood pressure and echocardiogram findings of left atrial enlargement and pulmonary hypertension suggest hypertensive heart disease.
The patient's echocardiogram findings of normal left ventricular ejection fraction, left atrial enlargement, and pulmonary hypertension suggest cardiomyopathy.
